Entity Framework Core support for Paduraksa.TypedIds: one model convention maps every typed ID to a binary or integer column (or, opt-in, the provider's native uuid type), with its ordering intact, and as a string inside JSON. Seeds the Int64 generator from the stored keys at startup.

Strongly typed, prefixed IDs for .NET: a source generator makes one struct per entity (user_ plus 22 base62 characters), as a time-ordered UUIDv7, a random UUIDv4 or an ordered Int64. Allocation-free formatting and parsing; System.Text.Json and TypeConverter support built in.
